    <style>:root {
    --bg: #fffbef;
    --fg: #111;
    --primary: #ff4d6d;
    --ink: #fff;
    --danger: #ff3b30;
    --success: #2ecc71;
    --card: #fff;
    --muted: #666;
    --shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15);
    --chip-bg: #fff7c8;
    --chip-hover-bg: #fff1a1;
    --chip-selected-bg: #ffcc4d;
    --chip-selected-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #000, 3px 3px 0 #000;
    --chip-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000;
    --chip-hover-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #000;
    --chip-radio-accent: #ffcc4d;
    --chip-radio-size: 20px;
    --chip-border: #000;
    --chip-radio-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000;
    --chip-radio-dot-size: 10px;
    --chip-radio-color: #000;
    --chip-focus-ring: #000;
    --chip-text: #2b1b05;
    --start-button-bg: var(--primary);
    --start-button-hover-bg: #ff6f87;
    --start-button-disabled-bg: #ff99ae;
    --start-button-text: var(--ink);
    --start-button-disabled-text: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
    --start-button-shadow: 4px 6px 0 #000;
    --start-button-hover-shadow: 5px 7px 0 #000
}

html, body { height: 100% }

button { font-family: inherit; line-height: 1.25; color: inherit; }

body {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--fg);
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column
}

header {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 3;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fff0d6, #ffe5f0);
    border-bottom: 2px solid #ffd6e3
}

header h1 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(18px, 2.2vw, 28px);
    line-height: 1;
}
.header-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: nowrap; }
.aw-header-title-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.header-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; justify-content: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.aw-header-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; justify-content: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.aw-hearts-container { display: flex; align-items: center; }
.header-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.aw-bottombar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: nowrap; align-self: center; }
.header-nav .ghost { min-width: 80px; text-align: center; font-weight: 900; }

.avatar-menu-wrapper { position: relative; z-index: 70; }

@media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1199px) {
    header {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
        grid-template-areas:
            "header-left header-controls"
            "header-hearts header-hearts";
        align-items: center;
        column-gap: 20px;
        row-gap: 12px;
    }

    .header-left {
        grid-area: header-left;
        align-items: center;
        min-width: 0;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .aw-bottombar {
        align-self: center;
    }

    .aw-header-title-group {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 8px;
    }

    .header-right { display: contents; }

    .aw-header-controls {
        grid-area: header-controls;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        gap: 16px;
    }

    .aw-header-controls .ghost { flex: 0 0 auto; }

    .aw-hearts-container {
        grid-area: header-hearts;
        width: 100%;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    #hearts-bar {
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
    header {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
        grid-template-rows: auto auto;
        align-items: center;
        column-gap: 12px;
        row-gap: 8px;
        padding-top: 8px;
        padding-bottom: 8px;
        padding-left: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
        padding-right: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
    }

    .header-left,
    .header-right {
        display: contents;
    }

    .avatar-menu-wrapper {
        grid-column: 1;
        grid-row: 1;
    }

    .aw-header-title-group {
        grid-column: 2;
        grid-row: 1;
        justify-self: center;
        text-align: center;
        min-width: 0;
    }

    .aw-header-title-group h1 {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .aw-header-controls {
        grid-column: 3;
        grid-row: 1;
        justify-self: end;
        gap: 10px;
    }

    .aw-header-controls .ghost,
    #fs,
    #mute {
        min-height: 44px;
        min-width: 44px;
    }

    header #avatar-toggle { padding: 3px; border-width: 2px; box-shadow: none; }
    header #avatar-toggle .avatar-image { width: 36px; height: 36px; }

    .aw-header-controls { gap: 6px; flex-wrap: nowrap; }
    .aw-header-controls .ghost { padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 12px; box-shadow: none; border-width: 1px; }

    .aw-hearts-container {
        grid-column: 1 / 3;
        grid-row: 2;
        min-width: 0;
        justify-content: flex-start;
    }

    #hearts-bar {
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        padding: 8px;
        gap: 5px;
        border: 0;
        box-shadow: none;
        background: #ffe9be;
    }

    .aw-bottombar {
        grid-column: 3;
        grid-row: 2;
        justify-self: end;
        display: flex;
    }

    .aw-bottombar .header-nav { gap: 4px; flex-wrap: nowrap; }

    .aw-bottombar .ghost {
        min-height: 44px;
        min-width: 76px;
        padding: 8px 16px;
        font-size: 14px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 360px) {
        header {
            column-gap: 8px;
        }

        .aw-header-title-group h1 {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 1.15;
            word-break: keep-all;
        }

        .aw-bottombar .header-nav {
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .aw-bottombar .ghost {
            font-size: 15px;
            padding-inline: 8px;
        }

        .heart-icons {
            gap: 2px;
        }
    }
}

.avatar-menu-backdrop {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 160ms ease-in-out;
    z-index: 60;
}

.avatar-menu-backdrop[hidden] { display: none; }

.avatar-menu-backdrop--visible {
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
}

.avatar-button {
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    background: #fff;
    box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #000;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease;
}

#avatar-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0;
    padding: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 70;
}

#avatar-toggle .avatar-image {
    width: 46px;
    height: 46px;
}

.avatar-label {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.avatar-button:hover,
.avatar-button:focus-visible {
    transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.03);
    box-shadow: 4px 5px 0 #000;
    outline: none;
}

.avatar-image { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; display: block; }

.avatar-option {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    gap: 6px;
    width: 96px;
    height: auto;
    padding: 10px;
    border-radius: 18px;
}

.avatar-option .avatar-image {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
}

.avatar-option .avatar-label {
    text-align: center;
}

#avatar-menu {
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 8px);
    left: 0;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 12px;
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 20px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    min-width: 148px;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-12px) scale(.96);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 70;
}

#avatar-menu[hidden] { display: none; }

#avatar-menu.is-open {
    animation: avatar-menu-show 180ms ease-out forwards;
    pointer-events: auto;
}

#avatar-menu.is-closing {
    animation: avatar-menu-hide 160ms ease-in forwards;
}

@keyframes avatar-menu-show {
    0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-12px) scale(.96); }
    100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}

@keyframes avatar-menu-hide {
    0% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
    100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-12px) scale(.96); }
}

.visually-hidden {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    padding: 0;
    margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
}

.ghost {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    min-height: 44px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: #fff;
    border: 2px solid #000;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    font-weight: 800;
    box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000;
    cursor: pointer
}

.ghost[aria-pressed="true"] {
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--ink);
    box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #000;
}

#fs {
    flex: 0 0 44px;
    inline-size: 44px;
    block-size: 44px;
    padding: 6px;
    border-width: 3px;
    background: #fff7c8;
    box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #000;
}

.fullscreen-icon {
    display: block;
    inline-size: 26px;
    block-size: 26px;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
    filter: drop-shadow(2px 2px 0 #ffb6c7);
    transform: rotate(-6deg);
}

/* Hearts bar */
.hearts {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: center;
    column-gap: 10px;
    row-gap: 4px;
    width: 310px;
    max-width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    line-height: 1;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: #fff7c8;
    border: 2px solid #000;
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000;
}

.heart-count {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 900;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    color: #9d2749;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.heart-goal {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.2;
    color: #6d3d32;
}

.heart-icons {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    grid-row: 2;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(10, minmax(0, 1fr));
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    font-size: clamp(18px, 4.5vw, 24px);
}

.heart {
    display: inline-block;
    text-align: center;
    transform-origin: center;
    color: #d72a55;
}

.heart-empty { color: #946456; }

/* pop-in for new hearts */
.heart-enter { animation: heart-pop-in 300ms ease-out forwards; }
@keyframes heart-pop-in {
    0% { transform: scale(0); opacity: 0; }
    60% { transform: scale(1.25); opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
}

/* Bar feedback */
.hearts.pulse { animation: hearts-pulse .35s ease; }
@keyframes hearts-pulse {
    0% { transform: scale(1); }
    40% { transform: scale(1.02); }
    100% { transform: scale(1); }
}
.hearts.shake { animation: hearts-shake .35s ease; }
@keyframes hearts-shake {
    0%,100% { transform: translateX(0); }
    25% { transform: translateX(-4px); }
    50% { transform: translateX(3px); }
    75% { transform: translateX(-2px); }
}

/* Floating +1 / -1 */
.heart-delta {
    position: absolute;
    right: 4px;
    top: 4px;
    font-weight: 900;
    text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #000;
    animation: delta-float 800ms ease-out forwards;
    color: #000;
}
@keyframes delta-float {
    0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.9); opacity: 0; }
    10% { opacity: 1; }
    60% { transform: translateY(-12px) scale(1.05); }
    100% { transform: translateY(-22px) scale(1); opacity: 0; }
}

/* ---------- FX: flying/breaking hearts (positioned on <body>) ---------- */
.fx-heart {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 1000;
    pointer-events: none;
    font-size: 28px;
    filter: drop-shadow(2px 2px 0 #000);
    transform: translate(0,0) scale(1);
    opacity: 1;
}
/* Fly from source to target using CSS custom properties --dx/--dy */
.fx-heart.fly { transition: transform 600ms cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.2,1), opacity 600ms linear; }
.fx-heart.fly.go { transform: translate(var(--dx), var(--dy)) scale(.8); opacity: .95; }

/* Break at the hearts bar and fall */
.fx-heart.break { animation: heart-break 700ms ease-in forwards; }
@keyframes heart-break {
    0%   { transform: translate(-6px, -4px) rotate(0) scale(1);   opacity: 1; }
    40%  { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(-12deg) scale(1.1);  opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: translate(0, 30px) rotate(18deg) scale(.6); opacity: 0; }
}

main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 20px }
#screen-wheel { gap: 16px; align-content: center; min-height: 0; container-type: size; }

.card {
    width: min(760px, 100%);
    box-sizing: border-box;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 0;
    isolation: isolate;
    background: var(--card);
    border: 4px solid #000;
    border-radius: 28px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    padding: clamp(12px, 3vw, 28px);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: clamp(18px, 3vw, 28px);
}

.card::before {
    content: none;
}

.card__body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px);
    flex: 1 1 auto;
}

.card__body .grid { flex: 0 0 auto; }

.allergen-introduction {
    display: grid;
    gap: 8px;
    margin: 0;
}

.allergen-introduction > .title { margin: 0; width: fit-content; }

.title { margin: 0 0 10px 0; font-size: clamp(22px, 3.4vw, 34px) }

@keyframes title-attention {
    0%,
    100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
    30% { transform: scale(1.12); opacity: 1; }
    50% { opacity: .25; }
    70% { transform: scale(1.12); opacity: 1; }
}

.title--attention {
    transform-origin: left center;
    animation-name: title-attention;
    animation-duration: 420ms;
    animation-timing-function: ease-in-out;
    animation-iteration-count: 3;
    animation-direction: alternate;
    animation-fill-mode: none;
}
.muted { color: var(--muted) }
.actions { margin-top: clamp(18px, 2.6vw, 30px); padding-top: clamp(6px, 1.6vw, 14px) }

.card__actions {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

.card__actions:has(#loading[hidden]):has(#load-error[hidden]) { display: none; }

.card-actions__status {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-right: auto;
}

.card-actions__status .muted { margin: 0; }

/* Base buttons */
.btn { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 18px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer }
.btn.primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow) }
.btn.danger { background: var(--danger); color: #fff; box-shadow: 4px 6px 0 #000; border: 4px solid #000 }

.btn.start-button {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-direction: row;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    --start-button-icon-size: 28px;
    --start-button-icon-spacing: 10px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 900;
    inline-size: min(100%, 320px);
    align-self: center;
    min-height: 56px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    text-align: center;
    background-color: var(--start-button-bg);
    color: var(--start-button-text);
    border: 4px solid #000;
    box-shadow: var(--start-button-shadow);
    transition: background-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease, color 160ms ease;
}

.btn.start-button .start-button__icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    inline-size: var(--start-button-icon-size);
    block-size: var(--start-button-icon-size);
    margin-right: var(--start-button-icon-spacing);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.btn.start-button .start-button__icon svg,
.btn.start-button .start-button__icon img {
    display: block;
    inline-size: 100%;
    block-size: 100%;
}

.btn.start-button:hover,
.btn.start-button:focus-visible {
    background-color: var(--start-button-hover-bg);
    box-shadow: var(--start-button-hover-shadow);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    outline: none;
    color: var(--start-button-text);
}

.start-button[data-blocked="true"] {
    cursor: pointer;
    background-color: var(--start-button-disabled-bg);
    color: var(--start-button-disabled-text);
    box-shadow: var(--start-button-shadow);
    opacity: 0.82;
    transform: none;
}

.start-button[data-blocked="true"]:hover,
.start-button[data-blocked="true"]:focus-visible {
    background-color: var(--start-button-disabled-bg);
    box-shadow: var(--start-button-shadow);
    transform: none;
}

/* Unified center action button */
.btn.action { color: #fff; border: 4px solid #000; box-shadow: 4px 6px 0 #000; font-weight: 900; }
.btn.action.is-start { background: var(--success); }
.btn.action.is-stop { background: var(--danger); }

.grid { display: grid; gap: clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px) }

.allergen-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    grid-auto-rows: 1fr;
    gap: 8px;
}

.chip {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 56px;
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    grid-template-rows: auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 8px 6px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    background: var(--chip-bg);
    border: 2px solid #000;
    box-shadow: var(--chip-shadow);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: "Fredoka One", system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-synthesis: none;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--chip-text);
    transition: background-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease;
    line-height: 1.25;
}

.chip:hover,
.chip:focus-visible {
    background: var(--chip-hover-bg);
    box-shadow: var(--chip-hover-shadow);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    outline: none;
}

.chip--selected {
    --chip-bg: var(--chip-selected-bg);
    --chip-hover-bg: var(--chip-selected-bg);
    --chip-shadow: var(--chip-selected-shadow);
    --chip-hover-shadow: var(--chip-selected-shadow);
    background: var(--chip-bg);
    box-shadow: var(--chip-shadow);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.chip__radio {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1;
    inline-size: var(--chip-radio-size);
    block-size: var(--chip-radio-size);
    margin: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    accent-color: var(--chip-radio-accent);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.chip__radio:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid var(--chip-radio-accent);
    outline-offset: 2px;
}

.chip__label {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    line-height: 1.25;
}

.chip__emoji {
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 1;
    justify-self: center;
    line-height: 1;
    font-size: 20px;
}

body[data-screen="allergy"] #screen-allergy { padding: 12px; }

@media (max-width: 767px) {
    body[data-screen="allergy"] #screen-allergy { align-items: start; }
}

#reveal .banner { border: 1px solid #bcdfcc; border-radius: 18px; padding: 14px; gap: 14px; margin-top: 20px; }
#reveal .banner.bad { border-color: #f2b7bd; }
#reveal .face { width: 64px; height: 64px; flex: 0 0 64px; }
#result-text { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.35; }
#dish-ingredients { gap: 8px; margin-top: 20px; }
#dish-ingredients .ingredient { max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 8px 12px; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #e4dcd2; background: #f7f2eb; color: #443a33; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.3; }
#dish-ingredients .ingredient > span:first-child { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
#dish-ingredients .ingredient.bad { border-color: #eaa2ac; background: #ffe2e6; color: #8e1933; }
#dish-ingredients .emoji-large { font-size: 20px; }
#reveal .actions { margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 0; }
#reveal .actions .btn { background: #d72a55; width: 100%; min-height: 52px; border-radius: 16px; font-size: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #ac2043; }

@media (max-width: 767px) {
    main { padding: 20px 16px; }
    .status { font-size: 14px; margin-top: 0; }
    .wheel-instruction { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; }
    .badge { font-size: 14px; }
    .badge .emoji-large { font-size: 22px; }
    #wheel { border-width: 3px; box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #30251a; }
    #wheel-control { min-width: 0; width: 68%; border-width: 2px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #30251a; }
    #wheel-control[data-wheel-control-mode="stop"] { min-width: 0; width: 48%; }
    .wheel-control__continue { padding: 16px; font-size: 18px; }
    .wheel-control__restart { padding: 12px; font-size: 12px; border-left-width: 2px; }
}

@media (max-height: 480px) and (orientation: landscape) {
    #screen-wheel { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); }
    .wheel-wrap { width: min(100%, 100cqh); }
    #wheel-control { min-width: 0; width: 90%; }
    #wheel-control[data-wheel-control-mode="stop"] { min-width: 0; width: 70%; }
    .wheel-control__continue { padding: 12px; font-size: 16px; }
    .wheel-control__restart { padding: 10px; font-size: 12px; }
    #wheel-control[data-wheel-control-mode="stop"] .wheel-control__continue { padding-inline: 12px; }
    .reveal-card { border-radius: 20px; }
}

.row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 14px }
.tag { background: #d1f7ff; border: 2px solid #000; border-radius: 14px; padding: 6px 10px; font-weight: 800 }

.ingredients { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 12px }
.ingredient { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 2px solid #000; border-radius: 999px; background: #f4f4f4; font-weight: 700; cursor: default; }
.ingredient.bad { background: #ffd0d6 }
.ingredient .emoji-large { line-height: 1; }

.banner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 12px; border: 3px dashed #000; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px }
.banner #result-text { cursor: default; }
.ok { background: #d9fbe9 }
.bad { background: #ffe2e6 }

.face { width: 90px; height: 90px }

/* ---------- Emoji sizing helpers ---------- */
.emoji-large { font-size: 2em; }
/* Published mobile destinations share one compact, accessible installation section. */
#mobile-installation { margin: 1rem auto; padding: 1rem; max-width: 40rem; text-align: center; }
#mobile-installation h2 { font-size: 1.1rem; }
#mobile-installation a { display: inline-block; margin: .4rem; padding: .8rem 1rem; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 1rem; color: #172554; background: #fff; font-weight: bold; }

footer { padding: 1rem; text-align: center; }

#nav-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 6px;
    height: 44px;
    padding-block: 6px;
}

.header-destination-icon {
    display: block;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
}

#mute {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    min-width: 44px;
    padding: 4px;
}

.audio-icon { display: block; width: 32px; height: 32px; }
#mute[aria-pressed="false"] .audio-icon__cross,
#mute[aria-pressed="true"] .audio-icon__waves { display: none; }
</style>

</head>

<body data-screen="allergy">
<header>
    <div class="header-left">
        <div class="avatar-menu-wrapper">
            <button aria-expanded="false" aria-haspopup="true" class="avatar-button" id="avatar-toggle" type="button"></button>
            <div aria-hidden="true" class="avatar-menu-backdrop" id="avatar-menu-backdrop" hidden></div>
            <div class="avatar-menu" id="avatar-menu" hidden></div>
        </div>
        <div class="aw-header-title-group">
            <h1>Allergy Wheel</h1>
        </div>
        <div class="aw-bottombar">
            <nav class="header-nav">
                <button class="ghost" id="nav-toggle" type="button"></button>
            </nav>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="header-right">
        <div class="aw-hearts-container">
            <div aria-live="polite" class="hearts" data-count="0" id="hearts-bar" aria-label="0 of 10 hearts. Collect 10 hearts to win." title="0 of 10 hearts. Collect 10 hearts to win.">
                <span class="heart-count"></span>
                <span aria-hidden="true" class="heart-icons"></span>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="aw-header-controls">
            
            <button type="button" class="ghost" id="mute" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Mute audio">
                <svg aria-hidden="true" class="audio-icon" focusable="false" viewBox="0 0 64 64">
                    <path d="M9 24L23 23L39 10L41 53L23 40L10 41Z" fill="#ffcc4d" stroke="#111" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
                    <path d="M10 25L22 24L23 40L11 40Z" fill="#7bdff2" stroke="#111" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
                    <ellipse cx="29" cy="27" rx="2.5" ry="3.5" fill="#111"/>
                    <ellipse cx="35" cy="25" rx="2.5" ry="3.5" fill="#111"/>
                    <path d="M28 36Q33 41 37 34" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
                    <g class="audio-icon__waves" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                        <path d="M47 23Q54 31 47 39M54 16Q65 31 54 46" stroke="#111" stroke-width="7"/>
                        <path d="M47 23Q54 31 47 39M54 16Q65 31 54 46" stroke="#ff6f87" stroke-width="3"/>
                    </g>
                    <g class="audio-icon__cross" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
                        <path d="M13 11L53 53" stroke="#111" stroke-width="9"/>
                        <path d="M13 11L53 53" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="5"/>
                    </g>
                </svg>
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
</header>

<!-- Allergy selection -->
<main id="screen-allergy">
    <div class="card">
        <div class="card__body">
            <hgroup class="allergen-introduction">
                <h2 class="title" id="allergy-title">Pick your allergens</h2>
            </hgroup>
            <div class="grid allergen-grid" id="allergy-list"></div>
            <button
                aria-disabled="true"
                class="btn primary start-button"
                data-blocked="true"
                id="start"
                type="button"
            >
                <span aria-hidden="true" class="start-button__icon">
                    <img alt="" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,"/>
                </span>
                Spin the Wheel
            </button>
        </div>
        <div class="actions card__actions">
            <div class="card-actions__status">
                <p class="muted" id="loading">Loading data…</p>
                <p class="muted" hidden id="load-error">Could not load data. Check JSON paths.</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</main>

<!-- Wheel -->
<main id="screen-wheel">
    <div class="wheel-wrap">
        <canvas aria-label="Spinning dish wheel" height="1000" id="wheel" width="1000"></canvas>
        <!-- wheel control cluster; JS toggles .is-stop <-> .is-start on the main button -->
        <div class="wheel-control" data-wheel-control-mode="start" id="wheel-control">
            <button class="wheel-control__continue btn action is-start" id="wheel-continue" type="button">
                <span class="wheel-control__label wheel-control__label--spin">SPIN</span>
                <span class="wheel-control__label wheel-control__label--stop">STOP</span>
            </button>
            <div
                aria-hidden="false"
                class="wheel-control__restart"
                id="wheel-restart"
                role="button"
                tabindex="0"
            >
                Restart
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="status">
        <p class="wheel-instruction muted">Spin the allergy wheel to win 10 hearts!</p>
        Allergens: <span id="sel-badges"></span>
    </div>
    <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        class="restart-modal"
        hidden
        id="restart-confirmation"
    >
        <div class="restart-modal__overlay" id="restart-confirmation-overlay"></div>
        <div
            aria-describedby="restart-confirmation-description"
            aria-labelledby="restart-confirmation-title"
            aria-modal="true"
            class="restart-modal__dialog"
            id="restart-confirmation-dialog"
            role="dialog"
            tabindex="-1"
        >
            <h2 class="restart-modal__title" id="restart-confirmation-title">Restart the game?</h2>
            <p class="restart-modal__message" id="restart-confirmation-description">
                Are you sure you want to restart? Your current progress will be lost.
            </p>
            <div class="restart-modal__actions">
                <button class="btn danger restart-modal__confirm" id="restart-confirmation-confirm" type="button">
                    Yes, restart
                </button>
                <button class="ghost restart-modal__cancel" id="restart-confirmation-cancel" type="button">
                    Continue playing
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</main>

<!-- Menu -->
<section aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="menu-title" id="screen-menu">
    <div class="menu-card">
        <div class="menu-card__header">
            <h2 class="title" id="menu-title">Global Allergy-Friendly Menu</h2>
            <p class="muted">Browse every dish from the wheel with its colorful story.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-table-wrapper">
            <table aria-labelledby="menu-title" class="menu-table" role="table">
                <thead role="rowgroup">
                    <tr role="row">
                        <th role="columnheader" scope="col">Dish</th>
                        <th role="columnheader" scope="col">
                            <div class="menu-header-cell">
                                <button
                                    aria-controls="menu-ingredient-filter-panel"
                                    aria-expanded="false"
                                    aria-haspopup="true"
                                    class="menu-header-toggle"
                                    id="menu-ingredient-filter-toggle"
                                    type="button"
                                >
                                    Ingredients
                                </button>
                                <div
                                    aria-label="Filter ingredients"
                                    class="menu-filter-panel"
                                    hidden
                                    id="menu-ingredient-filter-panel"
                                    role="group"
                                >
                                    <div class="menu-filter-header">
                                        <p class="menu-filter-title">Filter by ingredient</p>
                                        <button
                                            aria-disabled="true"
                                            class="menu-filter-clear"
                                            id="menu-ingredient-filter-clear"
                                            type="button"
                                        >
                                            Clear
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="menu-filter-list" id="menu-ingredient-filter-list"></div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </th>
                        <th role="columnheader" scope="col">
                            <div class="menu-header-cell">
                                <button
                                    aria-controls="menu-cuisine-filter-panel"
                                    aria-expanded="false"
                                    aria-haspopup="true"
                                    class="menu-header-toggle"
                                    id="menu-cuisine-filter-toggle"
                                    type="button"
                                >
                                    Cuisine
                                </button>
                                <div
                                    aria-label="Filter cuisines"
                                    class="menu-filter-panel"
                                    hidden
                                    id="menu-cuisine-filter-panel"
                                    role="group"
                                >
                                    <div class="menu-filter-header">
                                        <p class="menu-filter-title">Filter by cuisine</p>
                                        <button
                                            aria-disabled="true"
                                            class="menu-filter-clear"
                                            id="menu-cuisine-filter-clear"
                                            type="button"
                                        >
                                            Clear
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="menu-filter-list" id="menu-cuisine-filter-list"></div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </th>
                        <th role="columnheader" scope="col">Story</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody id="menu-table-body" role="rowgroup"></tbody>
            </table>
        </div>
    </div>
</section>

<!-- Reveal -->
<section aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="dish-title" aria-modal="true" id="reveal" role="dialog">
    <div class="reveal-card">
        <div class="row">
            <h3 class="title" id="dish-title" style="margin:0"></h3>
            <span class="tag" id="dish-cuisine"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="banner ok" id="result">
            <svg class="face" hidden id="face" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
                <circle cx="50" cy="50" fill="#ffd1dc" r="45" stroke="#000" stroke-width="4"/>
                <circle cx="35" cy="40" r="6"/>
                <circle cx="65" cy="40" r="6"/>
                <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" fill="#ff9eb3" rx="22" ry="14" stroke="#000" stroke-width="4"/>
            </svg>
            <div id="result-text" style="font-weight:900"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="ingredients" id="dish-ingredients"></div>
        <div class="actions" style="text-align:right">
            <button class="btn primary" id="again">Spin Again</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</section>

<section aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="gameover-title" aria-modal="true" id="gameover" role="dialog">
    <div class="reveal-card" style="text-align:center">
        <h3 class="title" id="gameover-title" style="margin:0 0 6px 0">Game Over</h3>
        <p class="muted" style="margin:0 0 16px 0">You ran out of hearts. Want to try again?</p>
        <div class="actions" style="display:flex; gap:10px; justify-content:center">
            <button class="btn primary" id="restart">Restart</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</section>

<script src="data:text/javascript;base64,"></script>
</body>
